'''Thomas Ronsin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Paris tournament]] on 12 November 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down dueling]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base B-Wing swarm]], according to Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1455">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-paris-france-11-12-2000d1455/ paris-france-11-12-2000], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-paris-france-11-12-2000d1455/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
